messages:
Maria (CS): Quick sync on AcmeCorp private/VPC onboarding \u2014 need a short status update for networking, IAM, KMS, and audit logs before our weekly renewal review. @Sam @Jordan @Lee
Sam (SolutionsEng): Network peering is in place from our side. Shared expected CIDR and egress details with Acme:
```
Redwood endpoint CIDR: 10.20.0.0/16
Expected outbound: 0.0.0.0/0 via NAT
```
Waiting for their route table change and security-group rules. I also need the exact ARN of the CMK once created so we can test encrypt/decrypt.
AcmeCorp - Raj: We created the CMK in us-east-1 and opened the change request for routes. KMS ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd1234-ef56-7890-abcd-1234ef567890. Route update scheduled in the maintenance window tonight (02:00-03:00 UTC).
Jordan (Infra): Minimal key policy snippet you can attach to the CMK (or we can create a grant):
```
{
  "Sid": "AllowRedwoodService",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/redwood-private-controlplane"},
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```
Also confirm `redwood-private-data-role` exists in your account and trust relationship allows assume-role from the control plane.
Lee (Security): Audit logging checklist for compliance:
- Enable CloudTrail for all management and data events
- Deliver logs to an S3 bucket encrypted with the provided CMK
- Bucket policy: require TLS, deny PutObject unless from `arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/redwood-audit-role` or the account root
- Retention: default 1 year; speak up if you need longer (e.g., PCI/IR requirements)
AcmeCorp - Raj: Created bucket `acme-redwood-audit`, lifecycle rule 1 year, enforced TLS-only. Gave `arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/redwood-audit-role` PutObject.
deploy-bot: VPC peering connection pcx-0a1b2c3d accepted by acme-vpc (automated).
Sam (SolutionsEng): Running smoke checks once route table change is applied:
1) curl health endpoint over peering
2) assume-role to `redwood-private-controlplane`
3) KMS Encrypt/Decrypt roundtrip against the CMK
I'll paste any failing logs here.
AcmeCorp - Raj: Route table change applied at 02:12 UTC; awaiting your tests.
Sam (SolutionsEng): Smoke tests pass: health endpoint reachable, assume-role works, KMS encrypt/decrypt OK. Verified CloudTrail objects delivered to `acme-redwood-audit` and encrypted with the supplied CMK. :white_check_mark:
Maria (CS): Thanks team 10. Marking infra tasks green. For renewal risk: because the route change missed initial schedule, flag Acme as "watch" for next 14 days on adoption metrics (latency, error rate, token consumption). I'll run an enablement session for their app team next Wed to go over observability, traces, and rollout checklist. @Raj can you confirm attendees (platform lead + security SME)?
AcmeCorp - Raj: Confirmed 12. Platform lead and security SME will attend. Anything else needed from our side?
Sam (SolutionsEng): Please provide an IP allowlist entry for our control plane: 54.23.12.34/32 so we can lock down management plane access for the duration of onboarding. Also, if you want automated log validation we can enable a short-lived IAM user to run a validation Lambda.
Maria (CS): Noted. I'll include the allowlist ask in the enablement invite and add a follow-up action for automated log checks. Closing this thread for now; will reopen if any regressions show up in the 14-day watch period.
